task.description: WF-03 Step 7 (Doc Update) for ISS-0107 / GitHub #366. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry: tests/integration/helpers.zig now widens the bpm_test_migrations_public advisory lock to cover resetTestData()/applyCompatibilityShims() (eliminating a cross-binary Postgres deadlock (40P01) mechanism among the ~19+ test-integration binaries), and scopes lock_timeout to 90s specifically around the widened acquire (restored to 5s immediately after) to prevent the increased queue depth from triggering spurious 55P03 lock-timeout cancellations. This required two design rework cycles (a first implementation correctly closed the deadlock but surfaced the 55P03 interaction; the design was revised to add the scoped timeout, caught one internal contradiction in review, revised again, then verified). Cross-reference ISS-0107 and GitHub #366. Note ISS-0108 (GitHub #368) remains open as a separate issue: db_integration_test.zig TC-DB-01-01/02 still fail due to an unrelated unqualified schema_migrations reference resolving to a stray, actively-recreated tenant_default shadow table, plus a second defect in TC-DB-01-01's assertion checking tables that migration GBL-073 relocated out of public -- neither is affected by ISS-0107's fix. Mark docs/issues/ISS-0107.json status RESOLVED with resolved_at, resolution, and prevention fields filled in (the rework history is a useful prevention lesson: design review should proactively consider timeout/lock-contention interactions when widening any critical section, not just discover them empirically). Update docs/issues/issue_index.json for ISS-0107.
acceptance_criteria: CHANGELOG.md has a new entry for this fix, under the current version/unreleased section
docs/issues/ISS-0107.json status is RESOLVED with resolved_at, resolution, prevention filled
docs/issues/issue_index.json reflects RESOLVED status for ISS-0107
ISS-0108/GitHub #368 clearly noted as a separate follow-up, not resolved by this change

Consider whether docs/anti-patterns.md warrants a new entry for the "widening a critical section without checking interaction with an existing timeout" class of defect -- add one if it seems like a reusable lesson for future agents, following the existing table format

result.summary: Updated all 4 required doc artefacts for ISS-0107/GitHub #366 closure. CHANGELOG.md: added a new top entry describing the widened bpm_test_migrations_public advisory lock (now covering resetTestData()/applyCompatibilityShims()) and the scoped 90s/5s lock_timeout override around the widened acquire, including the 2-rework-cycle history and TEST-RUNNER's independent re-verification; explicitly notes ISS-0108/GitHub #368 remains open as an unrelated follow-up. docs/issues/ISS-0107.json: status set to RESOLVED, resolved_at stamped from real UTC clock, resolution and prevention fields added summarizing the fix and rework history; all existing fields (root_cause, chosen_resolution, verification_result, verification_result_rework1, etc.) left intact. docs/issues/issue_index.json: added a new ISS-0107 entry (schema matches the ISS-0106 entry) with status RESOLVED and matching resolved_at, inserted in the file's newest-first created_at ordering; last_updated bumped. docs/anti-patterns.md: added a new Database/Migrations table row for 'widening a critical section's scope without checking interaction with an existing timeout', cross-referencing GitHub #366/ISS-0107, following the exact existing row format.
